newsitem.title: UK: Thorn to appeal U.S. ruling on rental-buy.
newsitem.headline: Thorn to appeal U.S. ruling on rental-buy.

text.p: Britain's Thorn Plc said it would appeal a U.S. Court of Appeals decision affirming that its rental-purchase transactions in Minnesota are subject to consumer credit legislation.
It said in a statement that it was "very disappointed by this decision, which it considers incorrect."
The decision only applies to Minnesota, where Thorn currently has eight outlets out of over 1,300 in the U.S.
Rent-to-own dealerships have come under attack elsewhere in the U.S. for charging allegedly excessive rates of interests.
Earlier this year, a suit was brought against Thorn subsidiary Rent-a-Center in Kansas claiming it disguised its sales contracts as rental agreements to avoid state-mandated interest rate limits.
